storage_type.title: Storage Type
storage_type.description: The type of storage to use for the output files

max_file_size_mb.title: Max File Size (MB)
max_file_size_mb.description: Rolls a partition into a new parquet file once the current file reaches this size in MB. Fractional values are allowed. Defaults to 512 when unset

s3_access_key.title: AWS Access Key
s3_access_key.description: The AWS access key for authenticating S3 requests, typically a 20 character alphanumeric string

s3_bucket.title: S3 Bucket
s3_bucket.description: The name of an existing Amazon S3 bucket with appropriate access permissions to store output files

s3_path.title: S3 Path
s3_path.description: Specify the S3 bucket path (prefix) where data files will be written, typically starting with a '/' (e.g., '/data')

s3_region.title: S3 Region
s3_region.description: Specify the AWS region where the S3 bucket is hosted

s3_secret_key.title: AWS Secret Key
s3_secret_key.description: The AWS secret key for S3 authentication—typically 40+ characters long

s3_endpoint.title: S3 Endpoint
s3_endpoint.description: Specifies the endpoint URL for S3 compatible services (e.g., MinIO)

azure_auth_type.title: Azure Auth Type
azure_auth_type.description: How OLake authenticates to Azure Blob. managed-identity uses DefaultAzureCredential on the process (Entra VM IMDS and AKS workload identity). Not dest JSON client id/secret

azure_container_name.title: Azure Storage Container Name
azure_container_name.description: The name of an existing Azure storage container with appropriate access permissions to store output files

azure_path.title: Azure Path
azure_path.description: Specify the Azure path where data files will be written, typically starting with a '/' (e.g., '/data')

azure_storage_account_name.title: Azure Storage Account Name
azure_storage_account_name.description: The name of an existing Azure storage account with appropriate access permissions to store output files

azure_storage_account_key.title: Azure Storage Account Key
azure_storage_account_key.description: The Azure storage account key for authenticating Azure requests

azure_endpoint.title: Azure Endpoint
azure_endpoint.description: Blob service URL. Leave empty for https://{account}.blob.core.windows.net/. Use http://host:port/account for Azurite

azure_storage_account_name.title: Azure Storage Account Name
azure_storage_account_name.description: The name of an existing Azure storage account with appropriate access permissions to store output files

azure_sas_token.title: Azure SAS Token
azure_sas_token.description: User-supplied SAS query string. Expiry is defined on the token

azure_endpoint.title: Azure Endpoint
azure_endpoint.description: Blob service URL. Leave empty for https://{account}.blob.core.windows.net/. Use http://host:port/account for Azurite

azure_connection_string.title: Azure Connection String
azure_connection_string.description: Storage account connection string (AccountName, AccountKey, EndpointSuffix)
